SELECT 
  u.id as user_id,
  u.email,
  u.username,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'category_id', c.id,
      'category_slug', c.slug,
      'category_name', c.name,
      'priority', uc.priority,
      'is_active', uc.is_active
    ) ORDER BY uc.priority DESC
  ) as subscribed_categories
FROM users u
JOIN user_categories uc ON u.id = uc.user_id
JOIN categories c ON uc.category_id = c.id
WHERE uc.is_active = TRUE
  AND u.email_verified = TRUE
GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.username
HAVING COUNT(uc.category_id) > 0;

=-- Get user's read history
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.content_type,
  ci.created_at as interacted_at
FROM content_interactions ci
JOIN content c ON ci.content_id = c.id
WHERE ci.user_id = '{{$json.userId}}'
  AND ci.status IN ('read', 'in_progress')
  AND ci.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

=-- Select one high-quality paper per category
WITH user_categories AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY[{{$json.categories.map(c => "'" + c.category_id + "'").join(',')}}]::uuid[]) as category_id
),
ranked_papers AS (
  SELECT 
    c.*,
    cat.name as category_name,
    cat.slug as category_slug,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.category_id 
      ORDER BY 
        c.quality_score * 0.5 + 
        c.popularity_score * 0.3 + 
        (CASE WHEN c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 0.2 ELSE 0 END) DESC
    ) as rank
  FROM content c
  JOIN categories cat ON c.category_id = cat.id
  WHERE c.category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM user_categories)
    AND c.content_type = 'paper'
    AND c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
    {{$json.readContentIds.length > 0 ? "AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['" + $json.readContentIds.join("','") + "']::uuid[]))" : ""}}
    AND c.quality_score >= 0.7
)
SELECT 
  id,
  external_id,
  content_type,
  source,
  category_id,
  category_name,
  category_slug,
  title,
  description,
  url,
  thumbnail_url,
  author,
  published_at,
  duration,
  word_count,
  language,
  quality_score,
  popularity_score,
  'paper' as recommendation_type
FROM ranked_papers
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY quality_score DESC;

=-- Select videos based on user preferences
WITH user_categories AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY[{{$json.categories.map(c => "'" + c.category_id + "'").join(',')}}]::uuid[]) as category_id,
         unnest(ARRAY[{{$json.categories.map(c => c.weight).join(',')}}]) as weight
),
ranked_videos AS (
  SELECT 
    c.*,
    cat.name as category_name,
    cat.slug as category_slug,
    uc.weight as category_weight,
    (
      c.quality_score * 0.4 + 
      (c.popularity_score / 100000.0) * 0.3 +
      (CASE WHEN c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 0.2 ELSE 0.1 END) +
      uc.weight * 0.2
    ) as recommendation_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.category_id 
      ORDER BY (
        c.quality_score * 0.4 + 
        (c.popularity_score / 100000.0) * 0.3 +
        (CASE WHEN c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 0.2 ELSE 0.1 END) +
        uc.weight * 0.2
      ) DESC
    ) as rank
  FROM content c
  JOIN categories cat ON c.category_id = cat.id
  JOIN user_categories uc ON c.category_id = uc.category_id
  WHERE c.content_type = 'video'
    AND c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    {{$json.readContentIds.length > 0 ? "AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['" + $json.readContentIds.join("','") + "']::uuid[]))" : ""}}
    AND c.quality_score >= 0.6
    AND c.duration BETWEEN 300 AND 3600
)
SELECT 
  id,
  external_id,
  content_type,
  source,
  category_id,
  category_name,
  category_slug,
  title,
  description,
  url,
  thumbnail_url,
  author,
  published_at,
  duration,
  word_count,
  language,
  quality_score,
  popularity_score,
  recommendation_score,
  'video' as recommendation_type
FROM ranked_videos
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

=-- Select articles based on user preferences
WITH user_categories AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY[{{$json.categories.map(c => "'" + c.category_id + "'").join(',')}}]::uuid[]) as category_id,
         unnest(ARRAY[{{$json.categories.map(c => c.weight).join(',')}}]) as weight
),
ranked_articles AS (
  SELECT 
    c.*,
    cat.name as category_name,
    cat.slug as category_slug,
    uc.weight as category_weight,
    (
      c.quality_score * 0.5 + 
      (CASE WHEN c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 0.3 ELSE 0.1 END) +
      uc.weight * 0.2
    ) as recommendation_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.category_id 
      ORDER BY (
        c.quality_score * 0.5 + 
        (CASE WHEN c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 0.3 ELSE 0.1 END) +
        uc.weight * 0.2
      ) DESC
    ) as rank
  FROM content c
  JOIN categories cat ON c.category_id = cat.id
  JOIN user_categories uc ON c.category_id = uc.category_id
  WHERE c.content_type IN ('article', 'blog')
    AND c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    {{$json.readContentIds.length > 0 ? "AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['" + $json.readContentIds.join("','") + "']::uuid[]))" : ""}}
    AND c.quality_score >= 0.5
    AND c.word_count BETWEEN 300 AND 3000
)
SELECT 
  id,
  external_id,
  content_type,
  source,
  category_id,
  category_name,
  category_slug,
  title,
  description,
  url,
  thumbnail_url,
  author,
  published_at,
  duration,
  word_count,
  language,
  quality_score,
  popularity_score,
  recommendation_score,
  'article' as recommendation_type
FROM ranked_articles
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY recommendation_score DESC
LIMIT 15;

=INSERT INTO daily_recommendations (
  user_id,
  content_id,
  recommendation_date,
  recommendation_score,
  position
) VALUES (
  '{{$json.userId}}',
  '{{$json.contentId}}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  {{$json.recommendationScore}},
  {{$json.position}}
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, content_id, recommendation_date) DO UPDATE
SET recommendation_score = {{$json.recommendationScore}},
    position = {{$json.position}}
RETURNING *;
